title: CISEI SmartGrid Lab — public record and datasets
description: Public record of the CISEI SmartGrid Lab (PUC-PR): research reports, glossary, bibliography and versioned datasets of a physical 902–928 MHz frequency-hopping relay backhaul used for SCADA service experiments. Datasets are under data/<dataset_id>/v<version>/, each with a dataset card, codebook and manifest of SHA-256 hashes; the release notes name the dataset versions included.
